messages:
Maya Chen: FYI schema-lint blocked onboarding for model `ursa-alpha` in assets-team/weights.
Maya Chen: root errors: `weight_uri` missing scheme and tokenizer `special_tokens` has double-escaped null `\\\\u0000` which our parser flags.
Devin K: I can grab this now. Which file/PR?
Maya Chen: PR #842 in assets-team, path: assets/ursa-alpha/config.json. weight_uri is `redwood/models/ursa-alpha-4bit.pt` (no gs://) and tokenizer.special_tokens shows `\\\\u0000` in the JSON (double-escaped). CI message attached.
TJ: Reminder: schema enforcement now requires weight_uri to match ^(gs|s3):// — we tightened that to avoid ambiguous local paths in onboarding.
Samir: double-escape usually happens when export script JSON-encodes strings twice. Upstream exporter should output `\\u0000` once, not `\\\\u0000`.
Maya Chen: CI snippet: `schema-lint: error: weight_uri must be gs:// or s3://` & `schema-lint: error: tokenizer.special_tokens contains invalid escape sequence`.
Devin K: Quick remediation options:
- change weight_uri to `gs://redwood-inference-onboard/ursa-alpha-4bit.pt`
- replace double-escaped `\\\\u0000` with single-escaped `\\u0000` inside the JSON
Which is faster for you, Samir?
Samir: I can update the PR. Which bucket should I use for public onboarding test objects?
TJ: Use `gs://redwood-inference-onboard` for public; `gs://redwood-weights-prod` for private/prod.
Samir: updated in PR: now `gs://redwood-inference-onboard/ursa-alpha-4bit.pt` and tokenizer pad token set to "\\u0000".
ci-lint-bot: auto-note: re-run triggered for PR #842 -> schema-lint now passes weight_uri check; tokenizer escape rule downgraded to warning: `found double-escape, recommend exporter update`.
Leila: I can add a normalization pass to schema-lint that detects `\\\\u` patterns and normalizes to `\\u` while emitting a warning and linking to exporter docs. I prefer not to silently mutate without notifying authors.
Maya Chen: yes please add the warning + link. We want authors to fix exporter but not break onboarding for minor escape issues.
Devin K: I'll add a short note in onboarding docs: "weight_uri must start with gs:// or s3://. Tokenizer special_tokens should use single-escaped unicode sequences (e.g., `\\u0000`)."
Samir: pushed commit a1b2c3: PR updated and verified ACLs on the onboarding bucket (object is readable).
Leila: opened PR: https://git.redwood/p/r/schema-lint/normalize-escape-warning (adds normalization + tests + doc pointer)
Devin K: doc PR: https://git.redwood/p/docs/+/onboard-weight-uri-and-tokenizer-guidance
TJ: I'll add a one-line suggestion to the exporter template to avoid double-encoding strings. Probably a pre-commit hook suggestion.
Maya Chen: re-run of gate shows green. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: Action items recap:
- Leila: linter normalization + warning PR (links to exporter)
- Devin K: doc bullet explaining weight_uri and tokenizer escapes
- Samir: ensure ACLs and keep an eye on any other assets in the PR
- TJ: exporter template suggestion / infra ticket
Samir: will monitor, thanks.
Maya Chen: closing the loop here; ping this thread if anything else pops up.
